doc: Export selection rules for web/dot1/export_glb.py (Đợt 1, option C). Read by the background Blender process. Collections are matched by exact name and taken recursively (collection.all_objects). The process works on an in-memory copy of out/ze155_anim.blend and never saves it.

notes: anim_ax = the 18 ax_* collections = the 343 exterior objects of ze155 (one ax_* group each).

ax_always_replaced is hidden in the file (collection hide_render + layer hide_viewport); the script un-hides it in memory. screws_a/screws_b are left out (the interior screws replace them). ctx_sheet, ctx_melt_curtain, melt_heater_bands, die_body_bolts and die_heater_boxes are exported as-is (no split in Đợt 1; the web overrides the sheet and curtain materials).
ctx_floor is left out: procedural floor material, the web draws its own ground.

anim_int_context = A1b context objects that belong to the line: anim_ctx_scanner, anim_ctx_scanner_head, the 3 roll-axis empties anim_roll_axis_* (used as runtime pivots) with their 9 anim_roll_markers_* children.
All A1a + A1b interior objects (slice 1 and 2) are exported once: the export is one cheap re-runnable command, and the interior file is lazy-loaded. The web wires only the Đợt 1 states.
anim_cut holds only anim_cut_ghost_sc (anim_ghost_sc) and anim_cut_ghost_drive (anim_ghost_drive_gbx); the other anim_cut_* collections are empty.

int_screw_axis_a / int_screw_axis_b are the screw pivots (empties at Blender (0, ±0.071, 1.2)); their children (64 elements, 2 spline shafts, 4 pre-cut elements, 4 xsec caps, 2 gearbox output gears) rotate with them.

in_memory_only: for the included collections: layer_collection.exclude = False, layer_collection.hide_viewport = False, collection.hide_viewport = False
rotor empties int_screw_axis_a/b and anim_roll_axis_* rotation_euler = (0, 0, 0) (rest pose; already 0 in the saved file)
a temporary collection __web_<file> (not linked to the scene) holds the selected objects; it is passed as the exporter 'collection' argument
bpy.data.filepath, mtime and size of the .blend are checked before and after; no save call exists in the script
